features.name: MCP Server for Business Central
features.description: A new MCP server that makes all Business Central functionality available to AI and agents through the Model Context Protocol, an open protocol for standardizing how applications provide context to LLMs.
features.status_evidence_quote: In October we announced the public preview for Business Central MCP server here in version 27.1.
caveats: Feature management switch currently required, likely to change at general availability

features.name: Copilot Studio Integration
features.description: Business Central MCP server targets Copilot Studio as the prime client in the first iteration, allowing users to create agents and connect to Business Central data through a model context protocol connector.

features.name: Default Configuration with Read-Only Access
features.description: When no configuration is specified, users get a default configuration providing read-only access to all API pages in the system, with three default capabilities: look for actions, describe an action, and invoke an action.
caveats: Requires explicit configuration for write scenarios

features.name: MCP Configurations for Write Scenarios
features.description: MCP configurations allow write scenarios beyond the default read-only access, enabling more complex automation tasks. Detailed setup covered in follow-up videos.

features.name: AI-Driven Automation with LLM Orchestration
features.description: The vision is to use language models and orchestrators to automate both well-defined repetitive tasks and fuzzy tasks where input is less precise, beyond what traditional APIs can handle.

features.name: Multi-Product Agent Scenarios
features.description: MCP server enables agents to work with multiple Business Central and other systems simultaneously, gathering information from multiple sources and reasoning across them.

features.name: Feature Management Switch for MCP Server
features.description: In Business Central, the MCP server must be enabled through the feature management page by flipping it to all users. This is a preview feature that will likely change at general availability.
features.status_evidence_quote: Right now this is a preview feature. So we always have this feature management switch.
caveats: Likely to change at general availability
